shortBulletSummary: US April CPI exceeded forecasts at 3.8% YoY, diminishing hopes for Federal Reserve rate cuts and contributing to Bitcoin briefly falling below $80,000.
The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act is progressing in the US Senate, aiming to establish clearer regulatory frameworks for digital assets.
The ETH/BTC exchange rate continues to decline, reaching its lowest level in nearly ten months, indicating a rotation of capital towards Bitcoin.
Despite broader market volatility, institutional investment into spot Bitcoin ETFs remains robust, absorbing significant capital.
